text: Completed the standalone nonpublished Vector API spike without adding any Vector API reference to ravel-core or the root aggregate. AArch64 JDK 21.0.11 and JDK 25.0.1 receipts cover exact axis-0 sum, contiguous add, less-than, is-finite, and sine at sides 256 and 1024, with paired scalar controls, semantic parity, two-fork JMH, and GC profiles. At side 1024 vector/scalar speedups were: axis-0 1.40x/1.71x, is-finite 1.40x/1.39x, less-than 1.34x/1.27x, add 0.84x/1.00x, sine 0.56x/1.35x for JDK21/JDK25. JDK21 vector sine allocated 50,331,875 B/op, about 48 B/element, and triggered 11 collections; other vector controls had constant single-digit allocation. Go/no-go threshold is exact semantics, at least 1.20x on both supported JDKs, no included-kernel regression beyond 10 percent, no size-dependent allocation, AArch64 plus x86-64 proof, and incubator isolation. Decision: no-go for an optional artifact now; axis-0, less-than, and is-finite remain candidates after x86/fallback design, while add and sine are rejected. Packaging costs include module flags plus sbt-jmh ASM and Java-16 classfile workaround. Final gates: parity 10/10 cases per JDK, 20 timing rows and 10 GC rows per JDK, JDK25 fmtCheck plus 126 JVM, 126 JS, and 2+2 law tests, core isolation scan, and git diff --check. x86-64 runner was unavailable and is recorded as a promotion blocker, not omitted evidence.
